How Does Jesse & Son Compare with Other Bangkok Tailors?

Bangkok is known worldwide for custom tailoring, with hundreds of tailors across Sukhumvit, Silom and the city centre. However, choosing the right tailor can still feel overwhelming. Many guides simply list the “best tailors in Bangkok” without explaining the practical differences in fit, construction, service, pricing and turnaround time.

This comparison looks at Jesse & Son alongside several well-known Bangkok tailors, including Rajawongse Clothier, Universal Tailor, Tom’s Fashion and Signature’s Collection. Rather than focusing only on reputation, the aim is to help you understand which tailoring experience may suit your needs.

A traveller with only a few days in Bangkok may prioritise speed. Someone preparing for a wedding may value detailed fittings and formalwear expertise. A returning business traveller may be looking for a tailor who keeps measurements on file and understands their existing wardrobe.

What Should You Look for When Comparing Bangkok Tailors?

Before comparing individual tailoring houses, it helps to look at the factors that have the biggest impact on the finished garment.

Criteria What to Consider
Fabric quality Fabric source, weight, breathability, drape and suitability for your lifestyle
Fit and construction Pattern cutting, fittings, internal construction, stitching and overall comfort
Service experience Consultation quality, communication, style guidance and after-service support
Price transparency Clear package details, fabric upgrades, fitting arrangements and included alterations
Turnaround time Number of fittings, production schedule and whether the tailor can accommodate a short Bangkok visit

The right tailor is not always the cheapest, most famous or most heavily advertised. It is the one that understands how you will wear the garment and gives you enough time to achieve the right fit.

What Makes Jesse & Son Different from Other Bangkok Tailors?

We Combine Family-Run Service with Decades of Tailoring Experience

At Jesse & Son, we are a family-run bespoke tailor in Bangkok, based on Sukhumvit Soi 10. Our tailoring history began in Udonthani before developing into a Bangkok tailoring house serving local clients and travellers from around the world.

We believe experience matters because a tailor needs to understand more than measurements. They need to recognise how different body shapes affect fit, how fabrics behave over time and how a garment should perform in Bangkok’s climate, at a business meeting, during a wedding or while travelling.

For a closer look at our background and approach, we share our story and the evolution of Thai tailoring here.

We Focus on Consultation, Fit and Long-Term Wear

A typical appointment with us begins with a conversation about what you need. We ask about the occasion, your existing wardrobe, your preferred style, your travel schedule and how often you expect to wear the garment.

For example, a suit for daily Bangkok business wear may need lighter fabric and less internal structure than a formal wedding tuxedo. A client travelling regularly between Thailand and Europe may need a cloth with good recovery, breathability and versatility.

We then take detailed measurements and guide you through fabric, lining, lapel, button, pocket and trouser options. During the fitting process, we assess the balance of the jacket, shoulder line, sleeve length, trouser break and ease of movement before final finishing.

For first-time clients, we explain what to expect when visiting a tailor in Bangkok, including how fittings work and what to prepare before your appointment.

What Does a Suit from Jesse & Son Cost?

Our prices vary depending on the selected fabric, garment style, construction and customisation required.

Item Typical Price Range
2-Piece Suit $350-$800
Shirt $58-$120
Tuxedo $500-$950
Overcoat $400-$750
Trousers Only $120-$250

A tailored suit is not simply a fabric purchase. The value also comes from measurement, fitting, pattern work, construction, finishing and the ability to return for future garments with your details already on file.

For current options, you can view our suit, shirt and trouser pricing here.

How Does Jesse & Son Compare with Rajawongse Clothier?

Rajawongse Clothier is one of Bangkok’s most recognised tailoring names. It is often associated with formal service, premium positioning and a traditional luxury experience.

Factor Jesse & Son Rajawongse Clothier
Suit price range $350-$800 Generally positioned at a higher price point
Service style Personal, conversational and detail-focused Formal, luxury-led and prestige-oriented
Location Sukhumvit Soi 10 Sukhumvit area
Fabric guidance Climate, lifestyle and garment-specific recommendations Broad premium fabric selection
Best suited to Clients seeking value, fit and a personal relationship Clients seeking a traditional luxury tailoring experience

Which Tailor Offers Better Value?

Rajawongse may appeal to clients who prioritise prestige, a highly formal consultation and a premium luxury environment.

At Jesse & Son, we are often a stronger fit for clients who want detailed tailoring advice without an overly formal experience. We focus on helping you choose the right garment for your lifestyle, whether that is a business suit, wedding outfit, travel blazer or everyday custom shirt.

Choose Jesse & Son if you prefer:

  • A relaxed, personal consultation

  • Clear guidance around fabrics and construction

  • A Sukhumvit location near Asoke

  • A tailor you can return to for future orders

  • Strong value within the mid-to-premium tailoring range

How Does Jesse & Son Compare with Universal Tailor?

Universal Tailor is another established Bangkok tailor, located in the Silom area. It may be especially convenient for travellers staying near Silom or Sathorn.

Factor Jesse & Son Universal Tailor
Location Sukhumvit Soi 10, near Asoke Silom area
Experience Family-run tailoring with decades of experience Long-running Bangkok tailoring operation
Service style Personal and relationship-led Larger operation with a broader team
Best suited to Clients staying in Sukhumvit or wanting an intimate experience Clients based in Silom or Sathorn

Is Jesse & Son or Universal Tailor Better for You?

Both may appeal to clients looking for established Bangkok tailoring rather than a low-cost tourist suit. The choice often comes down to location, consultation style and the type of experience you prefer.

Choose Jesse & Son if you value a family-business atmosphere, direct communication and a more personal fitting process. Choose Universal Tailor if you are staying in Silom or Sathorn and prefer a larger tailoring operation.

How Does Jesse & Son Compare with Tom’s Fashion?

Tom’s Fashion is known for accessible tailoring and fast turnaround options. It may appeal to travellers who need a simple suit quickly or who are working with a tighter initial budget.

Factor Jesse & Son Tom’s Fashion
Entry-level pricing Mid-range to premium Often lower entry-level pricing
Turnaround Typically planned around proper fittings Often focused on speed and efficiency
Personalisation High, with fabric and fit guidance More package-led and streamlined
Best suited to Clients building a long-term wardrobe Clients prioritising speed or lower entry cost

Why Choose Jesse & Son Instead of a Fast-Turnaround Tailor?

At Jesse & Son, we focus on creating garments that work beyond one occasion. We take time to understand how you want the suit to fit, what fabrics make sense for your climate and routine, and how the garment can work with the rest of your wardrobe.

Tom’s Fashion may be suitable when speed is the main priority. However, clients who value detailed fitting, personal style advice and long-term wear may prefer our approach.

For visitors with limited time in Bangkok, we also explain how to plan a suit fitting over three days.

How Does Jesse & Son Compare with Signature’s Collection?

Signature’s Collection has built a visible digital presence and may appeal to clients looking for a more trend-led or modern tailoring experience.

Factor Jesse & Son Signature’s Collection
Brand approach Family-run, experience-led tailoring Modern, digitally visible tailoring brand
Style direction Classic, versatile and personalised Contemporary and trend-conscious
Service focus Fit, fabric education and long-term client relationships Modern aesthetic and broader digital presentation
Best suited to Clients seeking classic bespoke service Clients seeking a younger, fashion-led experience

Which Tailor Is Better for Classic or Modern Style?

The answer depends on the wardrobe you want to build.

At Jesse & Son, we work with clients who want garments that remain relevant beyond one season. We can create modern silhouettes, but our focus is always on proportion, comfort and versatility rather than following short-term trends.

Signature’s Collection may appeal to clients who prefer a more fashion-led aesthetic. Jesse & Son may be the better choice for clients who want timeless businesswear, formalwear, wedding attire or a reliable travel wardrobe.

What Details Should You Check Before Ordering a Suit?

Ask About Suit Construction

Suit construction affects how the jacket sits on the body, how it moves and how it holds its shape over time.

Fused construction uses bonded interlining, while half-canvas and full-canvas jackets use a more structured internal layer. Half-canvas can offer a practical balance of shape and value, while full-canvas construction is often selected for clients who want a more refined drape and longer-term performance.

At Jesse & Son, we help clients choose construction based on the fabric, budget and intended use of the garment rather than simply recommending the most expensive option.

Prioritise Fit Over Labels

A suit can use excellent fabric and still look wrong if the fit is not properly assessed.

During a fitting, your tailor should consider:

  • Shoulder balance

  • Jacket length

  • Sleeve length

  • Lapel proportion

  • Chest and waist suppression

  • Trouser rise and break

  • Ease of movement when sitting or walking

A proper fitting process gives you the opportunity to refine these details before final finishing.

Choose Fabric That Works in Bangkok’s Climate

Bangkok’s heat and humidity can make fabric choice especially important. Heavy wool may work for a formal event or cooler destination, but it may not be practical for daily wear in Thailand.

Linen, lightweight wool, cotton, linen blends and tropical-weight fabrics can provide better breathability and comfort while maintaining a tailored appearance.

For more help choosing the right fabric, we break down the best fabrics for Bangkok’s humid climate. We also share tropical-weight fabric options for year-round suits in Thailand.

When Should You Choose Jesse & Son?

Jesse & Son may be the right choice if you:

  • Want a bespoke tailor in Bangkok with a personal consultation process

  • Prefer Sukhumvit Soi 10 for convenience and accessibility

  • Need help selecting fabrics for Bangkok, travel or warmer climates

  • Want a custom suit, shirt, tuxedo, blazer, trousers or wedding outfit

  • Value fitting, construction and long-term wardrobe planning

  • Plan to return to Bangkok and build an ongoing relationship with one tailor

You may prefer an alternative if your only priority is the lowest possible price, a same-day garment or a highly trend-driven look.

What Is the Final Verdict on Jesse & Son vs. Other Bangkok Tailors?

The best tailor in Bangkok depends on what matters most to you. Some clients will choose a tailor based on prestige, others on location, speed, budget or social-media visibility.

At Jesse & Son, we believe the strongest tailoring experience comes from understanding the client first. We combine family-run service, detailed measurements, thoughtful fabric recommendations and practical fitting advice to create garments that suit real lives. As a bkk tailor, our role is not simply to take measurements. We help you choose clothing that feels comfortable, looks refined and remains useful long after your trip to Bangkok.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who Are the Best Tailors in Bangkok?

The best tailor depends on your priorities. Some clients value prestige and luxury service, while others need speed, lower entry pricing or a specific location. Jesse & Son is a strong choice for clients seeking personalised service, classic bespoke tailoring, practical fabric guidance and a Sukhumvit location.

What Is Jesse & Son Known For?

We are known for family-run bespoke tailoring, personalised consultations and custom garments including suits, shirts, tuxedos, trousers and wedding outfits. We are based on Sukhumvit Soi 10 in Bangkok and work with local and international clients.

To learn more about our heritage, we share the Jesse & Son story here.

How Much Does a Bespoke Suit Cost in Bangkok?

Bespoke suit prices in Bangkok vary based on fabric, construction, customisation and the tailor’s experience. At Jesse & Son, a 2-piece suit typically ranges from $350-$800, depending on your selected fabric and design details.

Is Bangkok a Good Place to Have a Suit Made?

Bangkok can be an excellent place to have a suit made because it offers experienced tailors, broad fabric choice and efficient fitting timelines. The key is choosing a tailor who communicates clearly, understands your needs and allows sufficient time for fittings.

How Long Does It Take to Get a Suit Tailored in Bangkok?

Turnaround time depends on the garment, fitting schedule and tailor’s workload. Many Bangkok tailors can complete suits within several days, although clients should book early and allow time for fitting adjustments.

For travellers with a short stay, we explain how to organise a custom suit fitting in three days.

What Is the Difference Between Bespoke and Made-to-Measure?

Bespoke tailoring creates a garment around the individual client, using detailed measurements, fittings and customised design decisions. Made-to-measure tailoring adapts an existing pattern to your measurements. Both can produce good results, but bespoke generally provides greater flexibility for fit, comfort and personal style.
